rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the hemp plant and its cannabis products.

example.english: This hemp can be used to make rope, and some people smoke it.
example.traditional: 呢種大麻可以用嚟整繩，亦有人攞嚟吸食。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 daai6 maa4 ho2 ji5 jung6 lei4 zing2 sing4 jik6 jau5 jan4 lo2 lei4 kap1 sik6

rows.note: Use this for the hemp fibre or material used to make things such as cloth and rope, rather than for cannabis as a drug.

example.english: This hemp cloth feels cool to wear and is perfect for summer.
example.traditional: 呢件麻布着得好涼爽，夏天最啱。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 maa4 bou3 zoek6 dak1 hou2 loeng4 song2 haa6 tin1 zeoi3 ngaam1
